name: Penicillin selective culture for B. influenzae
summary: Fleming used penicillin mould juice on culture plates to kill other bacteria and isolate the influenza bacillus, penicillin's first described laboratory use.
description: Penicillium culture filtrate used on diagnostic culture plates to suppress other bacteria and isolate B. influenzae.
